supported_conclusions: Participant +0xEE and participant +0xF4 are independently initialized and independently mutated fields.
The winner's +0xEE had already reached 3 while +0xF4 was still 0, proving the fields are not aliases or two views of one counter.
Participant +0xF4 is an index/count for populated six-byte capture-history records beginning at participant +0x84.
The normal result path and an alternate or scripted result path append the same capture-history geometry.
The non-winning participant receives neither a capture-history entry nor a +0xF4 increment.
Participant +0xF4 is not the authoritative match-score counter and must not be used as the System 2.0 owner-behind or victory-state value.

Participant +0xEE remains the authoritative winner-updated match-progress field; checkpoint 3D will determine its exact victory threshold and finalize whether it is the captured-Gate count used to end the match.

system2_contract.rule: Do not substitute capture-history count +0xF4 for match score +0xEE.
